name: Rick Prime
description: The original, most ruthless Rick who killed C-137's family.

name: Evil Morty
description: A cunning and ruthless Morty who became President of the Citadel.

name: Rick Sanchez
description: A cynical, alcoholic super-genius on endless adventures.

name: Pickle Rick
description: Rick's pickle form, a testament to his genius and stubbornness.

name: Morty Smith
description: Rick's anxious and good-hearted grandson and frequent sidekick.

name: Birdperson
description: Rick's stoic, avian best friend and a freedom fighter.

name: Mr Meeseeks
description: A helpful being who exists only to fulfill a single request.

name: Summer Smith
description: Rick's granddaughter, a cynical teen often dragged on adventures.

name: Beth Smith
description: Rick's daughter, a skilled horse surgeon with abandonment issues.

name: Jerry Smith
description: Beth's insecure and simple-minded husband, often the butt of jokes.

name: Squanchy
description: A cat-like friend of Rick with a penchant for 'squanching'.

name: Tammy
description: Summer's high school friend and a secret Galactic Federation agent.

name: Noob-Noob
description: The Vindicators' intern and janitor, highly respected by Rick.

name: Mr Goldenfold
description: Morty's volatile and repressed math teacher.

name: Abradolf Lincler
description: A morally neutral genetic hybrid of Lincoln and Hitler.

name: Gearhead
description: A gear-headed alien and friend of Rick, also known as Revolio Clockberg, Jr.

name: Jessica
description: Morty's long-time crush, a popular and kind-hearted student.

name: Principal Vagina
description: The aptly named principal of Harry Herpson High School.

name: Mr Poopybutthole
description: A cheerful, long-time family friend of the Smiths. Ooo-wee!

name: Unity
description: A powerful hive-mind entity and one of Rick's former lovers.

name: Krombopulos Michael
description: A cheerful Gromflomite assassin who just loves killing.

name: Zeep Xanflorp
description: A scientist from the microverse inside Rick's car battery.

name: Ants-in-my-eyes Johnson
description: A hapless store owner who can't see because of ants in his eyes.

name: Death
description: The Grim Reaper himself, a recurring and surprisingly mundane character.

name: Stewie Griffin
description: The family's diabolical baby, bent on world domination.

name: Brian Griffin
description: The family's talking dog, an aspiring writer with a drinking problem.

name: Peter Griffin
description: The bumbling, childish, and impulsive patriarch of the Griffin family.

name: Lois Griffin
description: Peter's long-suffering wife and the voice of reason in the household.

name: Glenn Quagmire
description: The Griffins' hypersexual neighbor, known for his catchphrase 'Giggity'.

name: Meg Griffin
description: The family's unpopular and frequently abused teenage daughter.

name: Ernie the Giant Chicken
description: Peter's archenemy, leading to long, epic, destructive fights.

name: Chris Griffin
description: The Griffins' dim-witted, overweight, and awkward teenage son.

name: Joe Swanson
description: A paraplegic police officer and one of Peter's best friends.

name: Cleveland Brown
description: Peter's mild-mannered friend with a calm demeanor.

name: Tom Tucker
description: The pompous and self-centered anchor for Quahog 5 News.

name: Herbert
description: An elderly, perverted neighbor with an unrequited love for Chris.

name: Dr Hartman
description: The Griffins' incompetent but well-meaning family doctor.

name: Mort Goldman
description: A neurotic and nerdy pharmacist in Quahog.

name: Angela
description: Peter's perpetually unimpressed and stern boss at the Pawtucket Brewery.

name: Consuela
description: A stubborn cleaning lady with the catchphrase 'No... no...'

name: Bruce
description: A folksy, mustachioed man who works various jobs around Quahog.

name: Seamus
description: A crusty old fisherman with wooden arms and legs.

name: Bonnie Swanson
description: Joe's soft-spoken wife, who was pregnant for many seasons.

name: Opie
description: Peter's mentally-challenged co-worker at the Pawtucket Brewery.

name: Adam West
description: The eccentric and delusional mayor of Quahog.

name: Carl
description: The convenience store clerk, obsessed with movies.

name: Tricia Takanawa
description: Quahog 5 News's deadpan and persistent Asian correspondent.

name: Doodlebob
description: A chaotic drawing of SpongeBob brought to life by a magic pencil.

name: SpongeBob
description: An optimistic sea sponge who works as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab.

name: Patrick Star
description: SpongeBob's best friend, a dim-witted but loyal pink starfish.

name: Mr Krabs
description: The greedy, money-obsessed owner of the Krusty Krab.

name: Sandy Cheeks
description: A brilliant Texan squirrel and scientist living in an underwater treedome.

name: Squidward Tentacles
description: SpongeBob's cynical neighbor, a perpetually annoyed octopus.

name: Plankton
description: A tiny, evil genius trying to steal the Krabby Patty secret formula.

name: Larry the Lobster
description: A muscular lobster who works as a lifeguard at Goo Lagoon.

name: Mermaid Man
description: A semi-retired, elderly superhero idolized by SpongeBob.

name: Barnacle Boy
description: Mermaid Man's cynical and long-suffering sidekick.

name: Pearl Krabs
description: Mr Krabs' teenage sperm whale daughter who loves fashion.

name: Karen
description: Plankton's sarcastic computer wife and sidekick (W.I.F.E.).

name: Fred
description: A brown fish famous for screaming 'My leg!' during moments of chaos.

name: Perch Perkins
description: The resident news reporter for Bikini Bottom News.

name: Bubble Bass
description: An obese, picky, and arrogant bass who was SpongeBob's rival.

name: Scooter
description: A laid-back, purple fish often seen surfing at Goo Lagoon. 'Dude!'

name: Old Man Walker
description: An elderly fish who is a recurring background character.

name: Harold
description: A blue fish with a shark-like fin, often seen around Bikini Bottom.

name: Nancy
description: A small, gray fish with a yellow dress, often seen in crowds.

name: Tom
description: A green fish known for his intense love of chocolate.

name: Nat Peterson
description: A yellow fish who is one of the most loyal customers of the Krusty Krab.

name: Flats the Flounder
description: A tough flounder who was SpongeBob's bully at boating school.

name: Homer Simpson
description: The lazy, doughnut-loving patriarch of the Simpson family.

name: Bart Simpson
description: Homer and Marge's mischievous and rebellious ten-year-old son.

name: Kang & Kodos
description: A duo of Rigellian aliens who frequently plot to conquer Earth.

name: Lisa Simpson
description: The highly intelligent, saxophone-playing, and moral middle child.

name: Marge Simpson
description: The patient, blue-haired matriarch and moral center of the family.

name: Mr Burns
description: The ancient, greedy owner of the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant.

name: Ned Flanders
description: The Simpsons' relentlessly cheerful and devoutly Christian neighbor.

name: Milhouse Van Houten
description: Bart's nerdy and perpetually unlucky best friend.

name: Moe
description: The grumpy and lonely bartender and owner of Moe's Tavern.

name: Chief Wiggum
description: The lazy and incompetent Chief of the Springfield Police.

name: Apu
description: The hard-working and friendly proprietor of the Kwik-E-Mart.

name: Sideshow Bob
description: A self-proclaimed genius with a vendetta against Bart Simpson.

name: Ralph Wiggum
description: Chief Wiggum's simple-minded son, known for his non-sequiturs.

name: Comic Book Guy
description: The sarcastic owner of The Android's Dungeon. 'Worst. Card. Ever.'

name: Patty
description: Marge's cynical, chain-smoking twin sister who despises Homer.

name: Selma
description: Marge's other cynical, chain-smoking twin sister who also despises Homer.

name: Martin Prince
description: A highly intelligent and effete student, often a target for bullies.

name: Lenny
description: Homer's co-worker and friend, often seen with Carl at Moe's Tavern.

name: Carl Carlson
description: Homer's other co-worker and friend, often seen with Lenny at Moe's Tavern.

name: Snake Jailbird
description: Springfield's resident career criminal and rebel. 'Bye-oh!'

name: Groundskeeper Willie
description: The hot-tempered, Scottish groundskeeper at Springfield Elementary.

name: Agnes Skinner
description: Principal Skinner's domineering and cantankerous elderly mother.

name: Sidious
description: Darth Sidious, ein dunkler Lord der Sith und Imperator des Galaktischen Imperiums.

name: Darth Vader
description: Einst ein heldenhafter Jedi, fiel er der dunklen Seite anheim und wurde zum gefürchteten Sith-Lord.

name: Anakin Skywalker
description: Der Auserwählte, dessen Fall zur dunklen Seite das Schicksal der Galaxis besiegelte.

name: Master Yoda
description: Ein weiser und mächtiger Großmeister des Jedi-Ordens mit unübertroffener Verbindung zur Macht.

name: Luke Skywalker
description: Ein Bauernjunge, der zum größten Helden der Rebellion und einem mächtigen Jedi-Meister wurde.

name: Death Star
description: Eine mondgroße Kampfstation des Imperiums mit der Fähigkeit, ganze Planeten zu zerstören.

name: Super Star Destroyer
description: Eines der größten Kriegsschiffe der imperialen Flotte, das als Flaggschiff dient.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
description: Ein legendärer Jedi-Meister und Mentor von Anakin und Luke Skywalker.

name: Kylo Ren
description: Der Meister der Ritter von Ren, zerrissen zwischen der hellen und dunklen Seite der Macht.

name: Ahsoka Tano
description: Ehemalige Jedi-Padawan, die zu einer eigenständigen und weisen Machtnutzerin heranwuchs.

name: General Grievous
description: Ein brillanter Stratege und gefürchteter Jedi-Jäger der Separatistenallianz.

name: Mace Windu
description: Ein ranghohes Mitglied des Jedi-Rates mit einem einzigartigen violetten Lichtschwert.

name: Boba Fett
description: Einer der berüchtigtsten Kopfgeldjäger der Galaxis in mandalorianischer Rüstung.

name: Leia Organa
description: Eine furchtlose Anführerin der Rebellenallianz und Prinzessin von Alderaan.

name: Rey Skywalker
description: Eine Schrottsammlerin, die ihr machtvolles Erbe entdeckt und zur Hoffnung der Jedi wird.

name: Star Destroyer
description: Das Rückgrat der imperialen Flotte, ein Symbol für die Macht des Imperiums.

name: Slave 1
description: Das berüchtigte Raumschiff der Kopfgeldjäger Jango und Boba Fett.

name: Millennium Falcon
description: Ein modifizierter corellianischer Frachter, bekannt als das schnellste Schrottstück der Galaxis.

name: X-Wing Squadron
description: Eine Staffel vielseitiger Sternenjäger, das Symbol der Rebellenallianz.

name: Tantive IV
description: Eine corellianische Korvette, die eine Schlüsselrolle in der Rebellion spielte.

name: TIE Bomber
description: Ein imperialer Sternenjäger für Bombenangriffe auf Hauptschiffe und planetare Ziele.

name: Captain Phasma
description: Kommandantin der Sturmtruppen der Ersten Ordnung in chromfarbener Rüstung.

name: Count Dooku
description: Ein ehemaliger Jedi-Meister, der zum Sith-Lord Darth Tyranus wurde.

name: Moff Tarkin
description: Ein hochrangiger imperialer Offizier, der den ersten Todesstern beaufsichtigte.

name: Chewbacca
description: Ein treuer Wookiee-Krieger und Kopilot des Millennium Falken.

name: Qui-Gon Jinn
description: Ein unkonventioneller Jedi-Meister, der Anakin Skywalker entdeckte.

name: Jango Fett
description: Ein mandalorianischer Kopfgeldjäger und Genvorlage für die Klonarmee.

name: Han Solo
description: Ein zynischer Schmuggler, der zum Helden der Rebellion wurde.

name: Padme Amidala
description: Die mutige Königin und spätere Senatorin von Naboo.

name: Poe Dameron
description: Ein wagemutiger und talentierter Sternenjägerpilot des Widerstands.

name: Cassian Andor
description: Ein engagierter Geheimdienstoffizier der Rebellenallianz.

name: Finn
description: Ein desertierter Sturmtruppler, der sich dem Widerstand anschloss.

name: Lando Calrissian
description: Ein charmanter Gauner und Baron-Administrator von Wolkenstadt.

name: Commander Cody
description: Ein loyaler Klon-Kommandant, der unter Obi-Wan Kenobi diente.

name: Captain Rex
description: Ein erfahrener Klon-Captain, der in der 501. Legion diente.

name: TIE Fighter
description: Der Standard-Sternenjäger des Galaktischen Imperiums, schnell und wendig.

name: AT-AT
description: Ein vierbeiniger Kampfläufer des Imperiums, der Furcht und Zerstörung verbreitet.

name: Y-Wing Bomber
description: Ein robuster und zuverlässiger Bomber der Rebellenallianz.

name: LAAT Gunship
description: Ein schwer bewaffnetes Truppentransportschiff der Republik.

name: Imperial Shuttle
description: Ein elegantes Transportschiff für hochrangige imperiale Offizielle.

name: Jedi Starfighter
description: Ein schneller Abfangjäger, der von Jedi-Rittern während der Klonkriege pilotiert wurde.

name: Rose Tico
description: Eine engagierte Mechanikerin des Widerstands, die an die gute Sache glaubt.

name: Greedo
description: Ein rodianischer Kopfgeldjäger mit einer fatalen Begegnung mit Han Solo.

name: Nien Nunb
description: Ein sullustanischer Pilot, der in der Schlacht von Endor kämpfte.

name: Shmi Skywalker
description: Anakin Skywalkers Mutter, eine Sklavin auf Tatooine.

name: Mon Mothma
description: Eine der Gründerinnen und Anführerinnen der Rebellenallianz.

name: Wedge Antilles
description: Ein legendärer X-Wing-Pilot, der an beiden Angriffen auf die Todessterne teilnahm.

name: Watto
description: Ein habgieriger toydarianischer Schrotthändler auf Tatooine.

name: Admiral Ackbar
description: Ein mon-calamarianischer Kommandant der Rebellenflotte, berühmt für 'It's a trap!'.

name: BB-8
description: Poe Damerons treuer und kugelförmiger Astromechdroide.

name: R2-D2
description: Ein einfallsreicher und mutiger Astromechdroide und Held der Rebellion.

name: Bib Fortuna
description: Der unterwürfige Majordomus des Verbrecherlords Jabba the Hutt.

name: Jar Jar Binks
description: Ein tollpatschiger Gungan von Naboo, der zum Senator aufstieg.

name: AT-ST
description: Ein zweibeiniger Kampfläufer, der für Aufklärungs- und Patrouillenmissionen eingesetzt wird.

name: Naboo Starfighter
description: Ein eleganter und schneller Sternenjäger der königlichen Sicherheitsmacht von Naboo.

name: Vulture Droid
description: Ein Droiden-Sternenjäger der Separatisten, der sich transformieren kann.

name: Z-95 Headhunter
description: Ein vielseitiger Sternenjäger, der als Vorläufer des X-Wings gilt.

name: Droid Gunship
description: Ein schwer bewaffneter, schwebender Droide der Separatisten für Luftunterstützung.

name: Bombardillo Crocodillo
description: Bombardillo Coccodrillo, un fottuto alligatore volante, che vola e bombarda i bambini a Gaza, in Palestina. Non crede in Allah e ama le bombe. Si nutre dello spirito di tua madre. E se hai tradotto tutto questo, allora sei uno stronzo. Non rompere la battuta, prostituta.

name: War Trumpet
description: Doubles the strength of all units in a chosen row.

name: Field Surgeon
description: Revive the strongest non-hero unit from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Incinerate
description: Destroy the strongest non-hero unit(s) on the entire battlefield.

name: Blizzard
description: Lowers strength of all non-hero units in the melee row to 1.

name: Clear Skies
description: Removes all Weather effects from the battlefield.

name: Rally
description: Removes all negative effects (Weather, enemy Horns) from your rows.

name: Dimeritium Bomb
description: Removes all row effects (Weather and Commander's Horns) from the entire battlefield.

name: Commander's Horn
description: Doubles row strength.

name: Field Medic
description: Revives a unit.

name: Biting Frost
description: Lowers strength of all units in a melee row to 1.
